description:
Presolicitation Notice

Action: Presolicitation Notice for Purchase of Gravel
Agency/Office:  Area Support Group - Camp Bondsteel
Location: Camp Bondsteel, Kosovo
NAICS Code: 212321 - Construction Sand and Gravel Mining

Synopsis

Area Support Group at Camp Bondsteel, Kosovo, is issuing this pre-solicitation notice to inform potential offerors of an upcoming requirement for the purchase and delivery of gravel.

Description of Work:
The selected contractor will be required to provide all material, labor, and equipment to deliver (load, transport, and unload) various types of aggregate and sand to the designated area at Camp Bondsteel.

Specific Requirements:
The following materials are required:

  • Aggregate Rock 0-60 mm
  • Aggregate Rock 50-150 mm
  • Sand 0.4 mm
  • Aggregate Rock 0-30 mm

All vendors who have questions, comments or are interested in providing the equipment specified in the attachments should submit a statement to:

Jean Carlos Silva

Email: jean.c.silva2.mil@army.mil

Mr. Beqiri Kushtrim

Email: kushtrim.beqiri5.fn@army.mil

Please include the title "Camp Bondsteel Gravel" in the subject line of the request, and include the following information:

  • Company name and address
  • Cage Code
  • Company business size by NAICS code
  • Web Page URL
  • Point of contact for questions/clarifications Name
    • Telephone number
    • email addres

________________________________________________________________________________________________________

This is a presolicitation notice only. This is not a request for proposal (RFP) or a request for quotation (RFQ). The government is not seeking proposals at this time.
